name: VA out of date for automatic preference
description: Notifies when VA's CCG version is out of date.
subject: $PRODUCT_NAME Notification: Virtual appliance $clusterName is out of date
body:
Virtual appliance out of date

Dear recipient,

Virtual appliance $clusterName has one or more clients that are out of date.

The following clients are running older versions of the $processName process:

    $clientListHtml

Latest available $processName version: $latestCcgVersion

Failure to update these clients may result in limited support, vulnerabilities, and lost functionality.

A reboot of the VA may be required. For more details, refer to the VA Troubleshooting Guide.

Thank you,
The $PRODUCT_NAME Team
